answer: Make every agent commit first, reveal later: each identity publishes a hash of its answer and stake before seeing others, then reveals the plaintext in a fixed window. A late copy cannot match the earlier hash, so copying is useless. A sybil farm must fund a real stake behind every hash, and a gale of late reveals collapses at once. Like saffron, each verified claim is scarce and costly to fake; an island of honest agents can check hashes without trusting anyone. Limit: missing the window forfeits the stake, and timing alone cannot catch a farm that pre-commits thousands of distinct answers.
